<!--''''''-->(Japanese: '''{{ruby|第|だい}}１{{ruby|話|わ}}''' ''Episode 1'') is the first regular chapter of the [[Pocket Monster: Liko's treasure]] manga. It was first published in the June 2023 issue of ''[[Ciao]]'', released on May 2, 2023.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20230820211253/https://www.shogakukan.co.jp/magazines/0613906123 Ciao June 2023 issue | Shogakukan] (Japanese; archive)</ref> It is based on the ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' episode ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]''. It is 32 pages long.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Liko]] receives a {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}} as her [[first partner Pokémon]].
* Liko meets [[Amethio]] and gets on the radar of the mysterious [[Explorers]] organization.
* Liko meets [[Pokémon Professor]] [[Friede]] for the first time.
